title: Escalating Exposure ramp across the storm, with and without item cooldown reduction
question: Does Escalating Exposure stack once per 0.7 s from storm ticks (12 stacks ~7.7 s), so its value grows with storm length, and does Transcendent Cooldown's item cooldown reduction shorten the ramp?
hypothesis: H-L5: per-second storm damage rises ~54% from second 1 to second 8 and stays flat; EE arm +43% total vs Mystic Vulnerability at the 18.4k state; Transcendent arm reaches the plateau ~2 s sooner (+1-2% total).

arms.name: EE_TC
arms.notes: same souls as EE not possible; compare ramp shape only

setup.position: mid lane, bots on a 300 u ring (inside the 40 m storm)

controls: Same position and spawn distance (enemies 3 at 300 u ring, main target 350 u)
hardreset between blocks (fresh cooldowns, no items)
Same souls/level/ability tiers (unlock 7) in every arm except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP keep-alive (ekeep 0.9) and resists
Arms interleaved A,B,A,B; A/A floor run first

decision.rule: EE/MV >= 1.3 supports keeping EE as the first 6.4k-class buy after the mid ult items
